fit.method: date-equal empirical 80th percentile of median-centered scaled residuals

decision: Retain calibration where average coverage and interval score improve across most tested scenarios, report effect sizes, seed consistency, interval width and local regressions. Confidence intervals express uncertainty; no all-subgroup significance veto.
primary: Nominal 80% interval coverage and interval score, for maximum high and minimum low at two and five days. Range and equal-target averages are supporting evidence.
comparisons: refreshed raw versus checkpoint-specific calibrated intervals on identical usable inputs
old calibrated versus refreshed calibrated on common usable stock-date inputs; verify exact preservation of prior point-MAE gains
controls: Freeze all 36 factors from their corresponding H1 data before scoring either H2 evaluation. Preserve the median exactly. No transfer of old factors; no full-distribution CRPS claim.
interpretation: Retrospective evaluation on previously examined windows. Calibration H1 also served for checkpoint selection, so it is not independent calibration data. No formal coverage guarantee. The old calibrated control used fixed 2023 H1 factors for both evaluation windows; end-to-end comparison changes predictor and calibration recency together.
